evidence.quote:
Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist in their first
week

observations.why: Mandating a checklist for all new hires appeals to security/stability (conservation) and structured capability-building (competence); the universal 'Every' frames it as a non-negotiable standard.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter

observations.why: Framing the checklist as a replacement for a prior system appeals to conservation — keeping what works by updating the stabilizing mechanism, not abandoning structure.
